remove_user_from_groups.description: When deleting a user, automatically remove them from all secondary groups.

remove_home.description: Remove the user's home directory and all its contents when the user is deleted. (This is *not* automatic by default in `deluser`. Use with care.)

remove_mail_spool.description: Remove the user's mail spool file (e.g., /var/mail/username) upon user deletion.

backup_to.description: Directory where backup tarballs of home directories will be stored (if backup = true).

backup.description: Create a compressed tarball backup of the user's home directory before deletion (requires `backup_to` to be set).

keep_groups.description: List of group names from which users should *not* be removed, even if `remove_user_from_groups` is enabled. Useful for shared or system groups.

items.description: A group name to preserve during group removal operations.
